task_meta.title: Fix an order-export importer that chokes on (and mis-totals) the real export file

claim_text:
`python -m importer exports/orders_2024-09.csv` now runs and produces the per-customer totals. They add up to **28,478.53**, the same figure as the summary line at the bottom of the export. All 12 tests pass (7 of them new), and August's results haven't changed.

| Customer | Sep
